notes: *your* in *Make your peace* answers to no possessive morpheme — the Hebrew writes בְרָכָה bare with no dative — so it is `added` under rule 18's closing sentence, which rule 15 expressly excludes from its supplied determiners.

Each distributive אִישׁ takes *every one* headed on the word carrying the lexeme (rule 31), and each chain's *of* goes to its rectum (rule 19). The margin's literal gloss was read and set aside (rule 38).
